title: Retention, integrity and chain of custody for logs

videos.script: A log that is gone cannot help you. A log nobody can vouch for cannot help much either. {{two}} This lesson is about the life of a log after it is written. How long to keep it, and who decides. {{keep}} How to get a copy off the machine that wrote it, as each line is written. {{ship}} How to show that a file has not changed since a given day. One hash for a file, and a chain of hashes for its lines. {{hash}} And the record that turns a copy into evidence: who held it, when, and what they did with it. {{custody}}
